title: CNO - Network Dependency Suppression
description: Storm-to-story v3: graph from NetBox edges; resolves each root's specific entity and targets it with a stable title so re-posting RENEWS one problem (fixes the 29-duplicate storm). Complements Davis native correlation (adds deterministic/graph-based + power-domain root cause).

input.query: timeseries e=count(cno.dep.uses), by:{`device.name`, `upstream.name`, link_type}, from:-2h | fieldsAdd n=arraySum(e) | filter n>0 | fields downstream=lower(`device.name`), upstream=lower(`upstream.name`), link_type

timeseries s=count(cno.if.oper_status), by:{sys_name, `dt.entity.network:device`}, from:-2h | fieldsAdd n=arraySum(s) | filter n>0 | fields device=lower(sys_name), entityId=`dt.entity.network:device` | dedup device

fetch logs, from:-45m | filter `log.source` == "network.config" or `log.source` == "cisco.syslog" | sort timestamp desc | fields ts=formatTimestamp(timestamp, format:"HH:mm:ss"), src=`log.source`, dev=lower(`host.name`), msg=substring(content, from:0, to:150) | limit 40
timeseries s=count(cno.if.oper_status), by:{sys_name}, from:-2m | fieldsAdd device=lower(sys_name), is_up=if(arraySum(s)>0,1,else:0) | fields device, is_up
